items.title: Insurers Faced Losses On Some Medical Plans After Years Without Repricing: BNM
items.summary: Bank Negara tells the PAC that extending protection against MHIT repricing hikes above 10% to all policyholders is unsustainable because some insurers incurred losses due to Covid without premium increases. These interim measures are set to end next month. The post Insurers Faced Losses On Some Medical Plans After Years Without Repricing: BNM appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: LIAM Denies Agents’ Claims Medical Insurance Products To Be Withdrawn January 2027
items.summary: LIAM says MediAsas won’t be the only option, denying insurance agents’ claim that ITOs will withdraw existing medical insurance/takaful products on Jan 1, 2027. At least one insurer, GE, will stop accepting new applications for individual medical products. items.title: MediAsas: Affordable Assurance Means Little Without Affordable Health Care
items.summary: We cannot build affordable medical assurance on top of an unaffordable health care system. There is no evidence that MediAsas will halt future premium increase. The government must confront the more difficult issue of making health care itself affordable. The post MediAsas: Affordable Assurance Means Little Without Affordable Health Care appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: National O&G Service Desperately Seeks Doctors For Temporary Sabah Deployment
